Title: THOCK Model 65
Body (HTML):
A 65% gasket-mounted keyboard machined from a single billet of 6063 aluminium. Five layers of foam, a polycarbonate plate, and a flex-cut PCB tuned for one thing: the sound.

Hot-swappable. QMK/VIA ready. South-facing RGB. USB-C with a detachable coiled cable.

Title: THOCK Model 75
Body (HTML):
The Model 65 with a function row and a rotary encoder. Same billet aluminium case, same gasket mount, same obsessive foam stack — 12 more keys.

Hot-swappable. QMK/VIA ready. Knob mapped to volume out of the box.

Title: Nocturne Linear 45g Switches
Body (HTML): Factory-lubed linear. 45g bottom-out, 3.4mm travel, POM stem in a nylon housing. Deep and muted — the switch we voice the Model 65 around.

Title: Copper Tactile 55g Switches
Body (HTML): A rounded tactile bump right at the top of the stroke, then a clean drop. 55g bottom-out. For people who want to feel the actuation without announcing it to the room.

Title: Sky Clicky 60g Switches
Body (HTML): A click-bar mechanism, not a click jacket — sharper, more consistent, and it resets with the same sound it fires with. 60g. Unapologetically loud.

Title: Obsidian Keycap Set
Body (HTML): Cherry-profile PBT, doubleshot legends that will outlive the board. 142 keys, covers 60% through full-size. Charcoal base, bone legends, a single ember accent on Escape.

Title: Milk Tea Keycap Set
Body (HTML): Cherry-profile PBT doubleshot in warm beige and muted brown. 142 keys. The colorway that got everyone into this hobby, done properly.

Title: Botanical Keycap Set
Body (HTML): Cherry-profile PBT doubleshot in deep green and cream, with a dye-sub novelty set. 148 keys. Limited run of 500.

Title: Aviator Coiled Cable
Body (HTML): Double-sleeved coiled USB-C with a machined aviator connector. 1.5m extended, 0.4m coiled. Matched to each colorway.

Title: Machined Wrist Rest
Body (HTML): Weighted to sit exactly flush with a Model 65. Choose cold-rolled aluminium or oiled walnut.

Title: Switch Service Kit
Body (HTML): Switch puller, keycap puller, opener, tweezers, brush, and a 5ml bottle of 205g0. Everything needed to pull a board apart and put it back together quieter.

Title: Hard Travel Case
Body (HTML): Die-cut EVA foam interior sized for 65% and 75% boards, with a cutout for a cable and a set of spare switches. Water-resistant shell.
